# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## Code Style & Language
- **Comments**: ALL code comments, docstrings, and inline documentation must be written in **English**.
- **Naming**: Use English for all variable names, function names, class names, and file names.
- **Commit Messages**: Write commit messages in English.

## Behavior
- When explaining code or answering questions in chat, you may use the language requested by the user (e.g., Polish), but the **generated code itself** must always follow the English-only rule for comments and naming.
